title: When the Gravity Sings Again
author: Wren Villalobos
blurb: Ulyana Quintana, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
